description: Galactic Falcons is a team of six passionate young innovators participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge. We combine creativity, research, technology, and teamwork to explore space-related challenges and develop innovative solutions. Our team believes in curiosity, collaboration, and turning ideas into meaningful projects that make science more accessible and engaging. United by our passion for space exploration, we aim to learn, create, and push the boundaries of what we can achieve together.
summary:
UNIVERSE SCANNER is an interactive astronomy platform developed by GALACTIC FALCONS for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, addressing the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge.

The platform aims to make infrared astronomical data more accessible through an integrated environment for exploration, analysis, and scientific investigation.

Its features include a SPHEREx Data Hub, an interactive analysis laboratory, a Cosmic Map powered by Aladin Lite, and a Research & Validation Hub. Users can explore astronomical images, inspect spectral information, compare observations from different epochs, visualize differences, examine FITS data, and document potential astronomical candidates.

The platform also provides known-object verification resources, candidate registration, discovery exploration, collaborative research tools, and structured research reports.

Our approach focuses on identifying potential changes in astronomical observations, evaluating data quality, and supporting further investigation using established astronomical resources.

UNIVERSE SCANNER aims to bridge the gap between complex astronomical archives and accessible scientific exploration, encouraging evidence-based discovery and greater public engagement with infrared astronomy.
